name: Legend of Ren'AI
source:
Legend of Ren'AI is an experimental visual novel that was created by automatically translating text that was generated by an artificial neural network into Ren'Py scripts. The neural network was fine-tuned with scripts from Legend of Everything, whose characters and settings are featured in this game.

It comes pre-scripted with dozens of AI generated scenarios & branching paths to explore, but advanced users can also generate new original scripts using the neural network model (OpenAI's GPT-2 “medium”).

[From [url=https://kidalang.itch.io/legend-of-renai]Itch[/url]]
translation:
《人AI传奇》是一部实验性视觉小说，通过将人工神经网络生成的文本自动翻译为Ren'Py脚本而创建。神经网络根据《万物传奇》的脚本进行了微调，该游戏的角色和设置都是该游戏的特色。

它预先编写了数十个AI生成的场景和可供探索的分支路径，但高级用户还可以使用神经网络模型（OpenAI的GPT-2“中”）生成新的原始脚本。

[来自[url=https://kidalang.itch.io/legend-of-renai]Itch[/url]]
